title: A block, then 24 of them
note: text = subtitles; say = spelled for the voice. Numbers from brain3d/trace.json, films/qkv_data.json, experiments/logs.

blocks.text: Attention is half of a block. The other half is a small network that works on each column by itself: the MLP. Attention gathers. The MLP thinks it over.
blocks.say: Attention is half of a block. The other half is a small network that works on each column by itself: the MLP. Attention gathers. The MLP thinks it over.

blocks.text: Stack 24 of these blocks, and you have the model. Every column climbs through all 24, changing a little at every floor.
blocks.say: Stack twenty-four of these blocks, and you have the model. Every column climbs through all twenty-four, changing a little at every floor.

blocks.text: Can we watch the answer forming? Take the last column after each block and ask it early: if you had to speak now, what would you say? This is the logit lens.
blocks.say: Can we watch the answer forming? Take the last column after each block and ask it early: if you had to speak now, what would you say? This is the logit lens.

blocks.text: For 17 blocks, the answer is noise: fragments of code, words from other languages. At block 18, a lowercase we appears for the first time. From block 22, We holds the top spot: 8 percent, then 29, then 56 at the top of the stack.
blocks.say: For seventeen blocks, the answer is noise: fragments of code, words from other languages. At block eighteen, a lowercase we appears for the first time. From block twenty-two, We holds the top spot: eight percent, then twenty-nine, then fifty-six at the top of the stack.

blocks.text: The answer is not looked up anywhere. It condenses, block by block, near the top of the machine.
blocks.say: The answer is not looked up anywhere. It condenses, block by block, near the top of the machine.
